headline: Westinghouse Air Brake Technologies (WAB) Stock Looks Near Fair Value On Cash Flow But Rich On Earnings
summary: Westinghouse Air Brake Technologies stock has delivered very strong long term returns over the past five years, yet the valuation checks suggest it no longer looks like a clear bargain, with the intrinsic value estimate from a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) model sitting close to the current share price while earnings based multiples lean expensive. Over the past five years, Westinghouse Air Brake Technologies has returned 237.1% which sets a high bar for any further upside to be justified by...
